milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The ice patch is a 5x5 area at spawn-relative (0, -1, 0). The player must navigate near the ice and face it (look down) to confirm visual discovery. Target is the center of the ice patch. max_distance=5 is generous since the player spawns on top of the ice. facing_tolerance=90 allows looking generally downward toward the ice.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green glazed terracotta is on the building's west wall at spawn-relative (5, 1, 9-10). Target is set to (5, 1, 10) — the center of the terracotta cluster at eye level. max_distance=8 allows the player to spot it while approaching the building from the packed ice path. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the terracotta wall.

Uses position_near_with_facing because the player must enter the building and get close to the brewing stand to interact with it. The brewing stand is at spawn-relative (8, 0, 10) inside the stone brick building. max_distance=3 ensures the player has actually entered the building through the doorway (not just standing outside). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is facing the brewing stand, which is required to right-click it. Note: the evaluator does not have a dedicated 'use_block' rule type, so proximity + facing is the best available proxy for interaction — the player must be within arm's reach and looking at the brewing stand.
